principle: Build the new user experience from existing project, work-thread, task, memory, focus, source and AI capabilities before creating new canonical entities.

product_shape.studio_internal_mapping: Existing Project scope plus current Work Thread and contextual layers
product_shape.compatibility_rule: Keep current Project IDs, Markdown formats, WORKOS naming and specialist routes during migration.

capability_mapping.treatment: Reuse Project as durable scope; replace separate project workbench over time.
Keep derived Work Thread but remove mode bar, graph, permanent queue and competing workbench layers.
Keep detailed editor as secondary route.
Keep service and fallback route; primary controls stay inline.
Keep durable review records as secondary depth.
Preserve formats; unify daily retrieval UX.
Preserve provenance and original source access.
Use underneath ranking/intervention; surface only when a decision needs them.
Contextual verification, not a daily destination.
Keep outside default Studio grammar until repeated real use proves value.

service_responsibilities.name: Context Compiler
service_responsibilities.purpose: Build the smallest useful Studio context packet from existing services.

service_responsibilities.name: Memory Governor
service_responsibilities.purpose: Admit, rank, verify, supersede and forget memory.

service_responsibilities.name: Attention Governor
service_responsibilities.purpose: Decide whether a signal or suggestion deserves visible attention now.

service_responsibilities.name: Action Governor
service_responsibilities.purpose: Decide whether work can continue, needs preview, or needs a checkpoint.

service_responsibilities.name: Recovery Ledger
service_responsibilities.purpose: Keep enough provenance, snapshots and outcomes to explain, undo, retry and resume.

implementation_sequence.name: Define Studio without new storage
implementation_sequence.goal: Document Studio as Project scope + Work Thread + contextual layers.

implementation_sequence.name: Build one thin Studio shell
implementation_sequence.goal: Goal, resume anchor, current artifact/thread, next action and one contextual drawer.

implementation_sequence.name: Absorb Project workbench
implementation_sequence.goal: Move context pack, Obsidian context, decision context, intervention and trail into optional Studio layers.

implementation_sequence.name: Compress task execution
implementation_sequence.goal: Capture, clarify, Focus, interruption parking, closeout and next-action handoff become one continuous flow.

implementation_sequence.name: Add Context Compiler
implementation_sequence.goal: Return one Studio context response rather than assembling many independent queries in the frontend.

implementation_sequence.name: Add AI sidecar
implementation_sequence.goal: Hermes/DIAL use the same context packet; AI-disabled remains first-class.

implementation_sequence.name: Hide secondary product grammar
implementation_sequence.goal: Remove old areas from normal navigation after contextual entry points exist.

implementation_sequence.name: Dogfood restart loop
implementation_sequence.goal: Measure 24-hour resume time, navigation decisions and closeout quality.

remove_from_main_experience: AI as a separate product area
north_star_interaction: Open Studio -> understand goal and state -> continue one useful action -> use context or AI only when needed -> leave a resume anchor -> return later without rebuilding the work in your head.
